messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
All their Christmas stuff was 75 % off but there was nothing that caught my eye.

output.original_text: All their Christmas stuff was 75 % off but there was nothing that caught my eye.
output.joy: All their Christmas stuff was 75% off, but I was still looking for just the right thing to catch my eye!
output.sadness: All their Christmas stuff was 75% off, yet sadly, nothing caught my eye.
output.fear: All their Christmas stuff was 75% off, but I hesitated—what if I missed something wonderful?
output.anger: All their Christmas stuff was 75% off, but it's infuriating there was nothing that caught my eye!
output.surprise: All their Christmas stuff was 75% off! I went in expecting a treasure, but nothing caught my eye!
output.disgust: All their Christmas stuff was 75% off, but honestly, nothing looked appealing to me.
